title: UK house prices show modest growth amid market uncertainty
summary:
UK house price growth remained subdued in June and July 2026, with major indices reporting annual increases between 0.6% and 2.2% as economic uncertainty and higher mortgage rates dampened buyer activity. Significant regional disparities persist, with Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland leading growth whilst London and the South East lag behind.

title: Buy-to-let investors secure larger discounts in slowing market
summary:
Buy-to-let investors negotiated larger discounts on property purchases in July, with 56% of offers coming in at least 10% below asking prices. Acceptance rates for these lower offers increased to 27% compared to 18% a year earlier.

title: Rightmove downgrades forecast with 2% price fall expected
summary:
Asking prices are forecast to fall by up to 2% this year, according to revised predictions from Rightmove, despite a brief uplift following the change in Prime Minister. The property portal had previously forecast that asking prices would increase by 2% in 2026.

title: Letting agents warned on tenant choice amid guarantor growth
summary:
Letting agents are being advised to ensure they promote consumer choice when recommending professional rent guarantor services, following implementation of the Renters' Rights Act. Industry observers suggest agencies offering only single providers could potentially breach the Tenant Fees Act.

title: Estate manager opens south coast office after £250k investment
summary:
Principle Estate Management has opened its first office on the south coast following an investment of more than £250,000. The company, which manages more than 26,000 units across Britain, has established a base in Fareham to service developments from East Sussex to the Devon coast.

title: AI tool analyses homeowner behaviour to predict instructions
summary:
Proptech firm Acaboom has introduced Behaviour Intelligence, an AI-powered system that analyses homeowner engagement patterns following property valuations. The technology draws on data from millions of homeowner interactions collected over more than a decade.

title: £17.5m care home development secures finance in Stratford
summary:
Puma Property Finance has provided £17.5m in development finance to Connaught Care for a 95-bed care home in Stratford-upon-Avon, Warwickshire. The facility marks the second Connaught project backed by the lender.

title: Lender advances £2.8m bridge on London commercial assets
summary:
TAB has completed a £2.8 million commercial bridging loan secured against two London commercial properties on a first-charge basis at 65% loan-to-value over a 12-month term. The loan forms part of a wider funding round totalling approximately £3.59 million in net advances across two facilities.

title: Landlords raise asking rents following bidding ban
summary:
Landlords are increasing asking rents in response to the Renters' Rights Act's ban on competitive bidding, according to data from Chestertons. Rightmove figures show asking rents rose 2.9% year-on-year in Q2 2026, the strongest growth in two years.

title: Industry voices call for property policy stability
summary:
Property industry professionals are raising concerns about the impact of frequent political changes and Budget timing on the UK housing market, ahead of the upcoming Budget scheduled for 28th October 2026.
